battle.name: 綦公順起義
battle.brief: 隋大業十三年（617），青州北海郡人綦公順聚眾三萬反隋，連破外城、進逼子城，卻在破城在望時鬆懈，被郡內明經出身的劉蘭成以百餘驍健壯士夜襲大營而全軍覆沒。卡面亞述長弓未隨軍而至，但亞述式的複合反曲弓正是當時中原步卒與騎兵手上的通用弓種：攻城靠它覆蓋城頭，野戰靠它成排齊射。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 交戰兩方：起義方是綦公順率領的北海郡起事群眾，核心為本地丁壯、逃亡兵卒與流民，首領綦公順自為統帥，沒有固定編制與統一軍令，先破外城，再立營於城外、包圍子城，步卒居主，輔以長槊手、搬石雜役與負責斷糧的小隊。守城方是隋朝北海郡的官軍與地方武裝：郡兵為主體，州兵、縣兵為補充，郡府佐吏劉蘭成主持城防，民間丁壯被臨時徵發上城垛；郡兵因連年征遼而缺額嚴重，甲械不足，全靠城牆、飛樓與弩機撐住。隋朝在山東的整體指揮體系是州郡各守其土，另由河南行台派出討逆大將軍追捕起事者，大業十二年楊義臣討張金稱、大業十三年薛世雄討竇建德都是這樣的臨時遠征編隊。官軍在同一戰區分散追捕，恰使各郡城守備只餘就地拼湊的殘兵，這是綦公順敢於以三萬眾強攻郡城的前提。義軍能聚到三萬，一半靠鄉里響應，一半靠截斷郡城周邊的糧道，運粟車隊一被截，城中存糧便只夠守軍支用。隋朝郡兵本以府兵番上為主，府兵制到隋末已名存實亡，郡兵多由縣兵、鄉兵與臨時募來的市人湊成，能守城而不能野戰，這也解釋了隋廷寧可四處拆將追截起事者，而不願就地集結大軍圍剿。
countriesEn: The two sides were the insurgents led by Qi Gongshun and the Sui garrison and local levies of Beihai Commandery. The rebel side was drawn above all from local able-bodied men, runaway soldiers and displaced peasants; Qi Gongshun was his own commander, with no fixed establishment and no unified chain of command. He first took the outer city, then pitched camp outside the walls and ringed the inner city, infantry forming the main body, supported by men with long spears, porters and small detachments sent out to cut the defenders off from supplies. The Sui side rested on the commandery troops, with prefectural and county levies as supplements; Liu Lancheng, an official of the commandery, directed the defence, and villagers were conscripted at short notice to man the parapets. After years of service in the campaigns against Goguryeo the commandery soldiers were badly under strength and short of armour and equipment, so the defence depended on the walls, the watchtowers and the crossbows mounted on them. At the wider level the Sui command in Shandong was a patchwork in which each prefecture and county guarded its own ground, while envoys of the Henan area office sent ad hoc commanders to hunt the insurgents, as Yang Yichen did against Zhang Jincheng in the twelfth year of Daye and Xue Shixiong against Dou Jiande in the thirteenth. Those pursuing columns were scattered across the province, so each commandery city was left defended by whatever troops could be scraped together locally, and that was exactly the condition that allowed Qi Gongshun to attack a commandery city with thirty thousand men. Half of the thirty thousand came from the response of the countryside and half from the cutting of the grain roads around the city; once the convoys carrying millet were intercepted, the stores inside the walls would only keep the garrison alive. The Sui commandery troops had originally rested on the fubing system of rotating service, but by the late Sui the fubing existed in name only, and the commanderies were manned by county levies, village militia and townsmen hired for the occasion, men who could hold a wall but could not fight a battle in the open. That too explains why the court preferred to dispatch columns to chase insurgents here and there rather than to concentrate a great army for a siege.
people: 關鍵人物有兩位。綦公順，北海郡人，生卒年不詳，隋末山東起義首領；大業十三年在郡境聚眾三萬，先破外城再進攻子城，見守軍糧盡便斷定破城在望，戒備隨之鬆懈，最後死在夜襲與隨後的潰亂之中，部眾亦隨之崩散。劉蘭成，以明經科第入仕，在北海郡任職，起義攻城期間主持城防；隋代文官常兼領兵，所以一個以經學取仕者亦可以主一郡城防，他正是憑這批精悍部眾守住外城與子城；城內缺糧、士氣低落的時候，他選出驍健壯士百餘人，潛出城外直搗綦公順大營，得手後城內守兵一併出城合擊，以內外夾攻扭轉攻守。同一戰區還有其他起義首領：清河漳南竇建德以高雞泊為基地，聚眾萬餘，於大業十三年正月稱長樂王；河曲的張金稱眾至數萬，大業十二年被楊義臣擊滅；豆子航「阿舅軍」劉霸道聚眾十餘萬；高雞泊另有孫安祖與高士達相繼起事。隋廷一方，煬帝楊廣仍在江都巡遊，河北山東同時有薛世雄、楊義臣等將領在外征討，太原李淵已舉兵，遼東與江都兩線仍留有重兵，隋朝全局已無可挽回。
peopleEn: Two men decide the story. Qi Gongshun was a native of Beihai Commandery, of unknown dates, and the leading rebel of the rising in Shandong. In the thirteenth year of Daye he gathered thirty thousand men inside the commandery, broke the outer city and then pressed the inner city; seeing that the defenders were out of grain he judged the fall of the city to be a matter of days, let his guard slacken, and was killed in the night attack and the rout that followed, his army breaking up with him. Liu Lancheng had entered office through the Mingjing degree and was serving in Beihai Commandery; under the Sui, officials of letters were often given command as well, so a man who had qualified through the study of the classics could be charged with the defence of a commandery city, and it was on such picked men that he held the outer city and the inner one. When the stores inside the walls ran short and morale sank, he picked a hundred of the bravest and strongest men, sent them out by night to fall on Qi Gongshun's main camp, and once the blow had landed led the garrison inside the walls out in turn, so that an attack from within and without reversed the situation. Other rebel leaders were working the same theatre: Dou Jiande, a native of Zhangnan in Qinghe, had made Gaoji Pool his base with more than ten thousand men and proclaimed himself Prince of Changle in the first month of the thirteenth year of Daye; Zhang Jincheng drew tens of thousands at Hequ and was destroyed by Yang Yichen in the twelfth year; Liu Badao of Douzihang headed the so-called Uncle Army and gathered more than a hundred thousand; Sun Anzu and Gao Shida rose at Gaoji Pool as well. On the Sui side the emperor Yang Guang was still touring Jiangdu, generals such as Xue Shixiong and Yang Yichen were chasing rebels across the north, Li Yuan had already raised troops at Taiyuan, and heavy armies were still held in the north-east and at Jiangdu; nothing could now save the dynasty.
kits: 起義軍與官軍的裝備集中在弓弩、槊、刀與攻城器械幾樣。卡面亞述長弓是公元前八世紀亞述王國的複合反曲弓，角木為胎、筋腱為裡，短矢快弦，形制上正是漢地弓的先型：同樣反曲省力，適合步行挽弓，也同樣供騎手在馬上急射，只是亞述人把它架在車上開弓，車兵靠弓兵開路。起義眾多為流民丁壯，弓用桑木或白木弓胎、角筋為弦，箭用柳葉箭與鳴鏑，配環首刀與削尖的竹木長槊，鎧甲極少，偶以木盾與車板充作護具；作戰口糧除粟、麥之外，也靠就食鄉里與截取運糧車隊，鹽、藜蒿、橡實都用來充飢。隋軍步卒有禁旅裝備的札甲與皮甲，長槊、橫刀之外配臂弩與蹶張弩一類強弓機關弩，箭鏃分骨鏃與鐵鏃兩等；攻城用矢石配石砲，另有巢車、偏箱車、拍車、撞車與雲梯，火油與火箭用來燒門樓，糧食則自洛陽與齊州沿河道運粟。城頭架飛樓、置弩機，居高以弩矢與弓矢封住城下射界，並備滾木礫石以打擊攀城者。亞述車上射的思路，在隋軍這裡對應車隊在弓手掩護下逐段推進、逼牆立弩；起義軍無車兵亦無重型器械，攻守完全繫在弓矢密度與士氣。
kitsEn: The equipment of both sides reduced to bows and crossbows, spears, blades and siege machines. The Assyrian bow on the card face is the composite reflex bow of the eighth century BC Assyria, horn and wood for the stave, sinew for the backing, short and fast-flying arrows; in form it is the ancestor of the Chinese bow, curved back to save strength, suited to a man walking and drawing, and equally suited to a rider loosing at speed, except that the Assyrians set it on a cart to shoot from, the chariot troops following the bowmen they covered. The rebels were mostly displaced peasants and village men: their bows had mulberry or white wood staves with horn and sinew backing, their arrows were willow-leaf shafts and whistling bolts, and they carried ring-pommel blades and sharpened bamboo or wooden pikes, with almost no armour at all and wooden shields or cart boards pressed into service as protection. Their food in the field was millet, wheat and whatever the countryside gave them, salt, broomcorn shoots and acorns serving to stay alive, together with grain taken from the convoys they intercepted. The Sui infantry had lamellar and leather armour of the guard regiments, and besides pikes and sabres they carried powerful crossbows, draw-strung engines and other mechanisms with a heavy bow, their arrows fitted with bone heads or with iron. For the assault they used stone missiles with throwers, and had siege towers, covered box carts, battering carts, rams and scaling ladders, with fire and oil to burn the gate towers, while their grain came by river and canal from Luoyang and from the district of Qi. On the walls they raised watchtowers and mounted crossbows, sealed the shooting ground below with bolt and arrow, and kept logs and stones ready to beat back those who reached the wall. The Assyrian idea of shooting from carts appears in the Sui army as wagon trains advancing stage by stage under cover of archers and crossbowmen planting their engines against the wall; the insurgents had neither carts nor heavy machines, and the whole contest rested on the density of their arrows and on morale.
tactics: 起義方是典型的流民攻城法：先以弓矢齊射壓住城頭射界，再以穴地、雲梯、火攻分段上城；破外城後立刻轉圍子城，卻不急於總攻，而是壕壘包圍、斷糧待斃，冀望守軍不戰自潰。包圍收得越緊，守軍糧盡越快，這正是起義軍倚賴拖延、避免正面硬拼的理由；義軍營盤多設在城北與東面近山一帶的村落與林地之間，便於分隊覓食，又便於夜裡收攏。破壞出在綦公順一方的鬆懈：他判定子城指日可取，便撤去部分包圍與警戒，營壘不設嚴哨，士卒連日攻城亦已疲憊。守城方走的正是最省力的路子，劉蘭成不再糾纏城頭，而是趁夜選出百餘驍健壯士出城，直趨敵營，先以近身械擊摧毀營中旗鼓與主將，再令城內守兵乘勢出擊，形成內外夾攻；這批人目標是主將與指揮，不是攻城器械，因為器械若毀，守軍反而多出破城的光陰。攻城方一旦失去首領與指揮，密集營盤在缺乏結界、壕壘保護之下瞬間瓦解，兵眾各自潰散。亞述式的車上射在隋軍手中成為車隊進逼的節奏：弓手掩護車陣逐段推進，弩手隨後立弩取角；而起義軍缺車兵缺器械，只能靠步兵弓陣與乘隙突擊。
tacticsEn: The rebels fought the siege the way hungry crowds always do. First a volley of arrows from the massed bows suppressed the firing lines on the wall, then the wall was climbed in stages by sapping, scaling ladders and fire; once the outer city fell they turned at once to surround the inner city, but they did not press the assault. Instead they dug in behind trenches, cut the defenders off from supplies and waited for hunger to do the work, hoping the garrison would surrender without a battle. The tighter the ring, the faster the stores inside ran out, and that was the reason the insurgents relied on delay rather than on storming. Their camps were pitched among the villages and wooded ground to the north and east of the city, close to the hills, so that the bands could forage in small parties and draw together again after dark. The collapse came from Qi Gongshun's own slackness: convinced the inner city would fall in days, he pulled back part of his investment and relaxed his watch, the camp was left without strict pickets, and the men were worn out by days of assault. The defenders then took the cheapest road available. Rather than keep hammering at the wall, Liu Lancheng chose a hundred of the bravest and strongest men, sent them out by night straight at the camp, broke the drums and standards and the commander with close-quarter blows, and then let the garrison inside the walls charge out in support, an attack from within and without. Their object was the commander and the direction of the army, not the siege machines, for had the machines been destroyed the defenders would only have gained time to take the wall. Once the besiegers lost their leader and their command, the crowded camp, undefended by any line or trench, came apart in an instant and the men scattered each on his own account. The Assyrian practice of shooting from carts became, in the Sui hands, the rhythm of the advancing wagon train: archers screened the carts as they came forward step by step, crossbowmen then set their engines against the wall. The insurgents had neither carts nor machines and could only rely on the bow line of the infantry and on attacks made in the gaps.
data: 可徵的數目有限，且多來自《隋書·劉蘭成傳》這類為守城者立傳的記載。起義眾三萬，是記錄中綦公順攻城的兵眾之數；夜襲出城的驍健壯士百餘，是記錄中最精確的一項。北海郡城分外城與子城兩重，外城既破，義軍以營盤圍住子城，靠斷糧逼守軍就範，記錄明載城中糧盡。時間上，此役繫於隋大業十三年，即公元六一七年；同在這一年正月，竇建德在樂壽稱長樂王，其部眾已達萬餘；大業十二年張金稱在河曲眾至數萬而為楊義臣所滅，大業十一年魏刀兒聚眾十萬，大業十二年林士弘部眾亦至十餘萬，可見山東與江南同時段民變規模之大。隋廷自大業七年王薄起義以來，兵役、徭役與轉運之征幾乎無歲無之，至大業十三年全國已無可調之兵，主力分置遼東、雁門、江都三線，山東無大軍可用。地理上，北海郡治益都縣在今山東青州，北倚海而南接雲門、仰天諸山，義軍集結多在城南山村。綦公順三萬眾、劉蘭成百餘壯士之外，義軍與官軍的傷亡、器械、弩機數目與糧秣存量均無記載，不宜臆造；此役的起訖月日，今存史料亦未見明文，僅可斷其在大業十三年上半年。
dataEn: The figures that can be vouched for are few, and most come from the biography of Liu Lancheng preserved in the History of Sui, that is, from an account written around the man who held the defence. Thirty thousand is the strength given for the insurgents besieging the city, and the hundred bravest and strongest men sent out in the night attack is the single most exact number in the record. Beihai had an outer city and an inner city; when the outer city fell the rebels ringed the inner one with their camp and tried to starve the garrison into surrender, and the record states plainly that the city ran out of grain. As to time, the affair is tied to the thirteenth year of Daye, that is the year 617; in the first month of that same year Dou Jiande proclaimed himself Prince of Changle at Leshou with a following of more than ten thousand; in the twelfth year Zhang Jincheng drew tens of thousands at Hequ and was destroyed by Yang Yichen; in the eleventh year Wei Daore gathered a hundred thousand; in the twelfth year Lin Shihong's bands also numbered more than a hundred thousand, which shows the scale of the revolts then running in Shandong and in the south of the Yangzi. Since the rising of Wang Bo in the seventh year of Daye the Sui court had levied troops, corvée labour and transport almost every single year, and by the thirteenth year there was no military force left to move anywhere in the empire, the main bodies being posted in the north-east, at Yanmen and at Jiangdu, with nothing large left in Shandong. Geographically, the seat of Beihai at Yidu lies in what is now Qingzhou in Shandong, with the sea to the north and the Yunmen and Yingtian hills to the south, and the insurgents gathered mainly among the mountain villages south of the city. Beyond the thirty thousand of Qi Gongshun and the hundred men of Liu Lancheng, no record gives the losses, equipment, number of crossbows or stores of grain on either side, and none should be invented; the exact months of the rising are likewise not set down in the surviving texts, and all that can be said is that it fell in the first half of the thirteenth year of Daye.
cause: 起義的根由，是隋朝在大業年間把山東抽乾。煬帝連年三次大舉征遼，徵發山東、河北丁役，建造戰船、輓運糧械，河北山東又連遭水災，饑民流散；大業七年王薄在長白山首義之後，山東河北起事接連不斷。地方守備被抽調去遼東與江都，郡兵空虛，糧秣與甲械多被上供，郡縣只剩老弱與臨時徵發的丁壯。綦公順是北海郡本地人，熟悉益都一帶的山川道路與村莊分布，能在官府耳目之下迅速集結三萬眾，又能把營盤安置在郡城近旁而不被發覺。隋廷本身也已經無法集中力量：河南行台的討逆將領四處追捕，兵到一處，起事又起一處，而同年北有劉武周起兵太原、南有蕭銑據巴陵，隋廷兩面受敵，中央更無餘力回頭收拾山東。同一時期山東尚有竇建德、張金稱、劉霸道、孫安祖、高士達等部彼此爭地，綦公順的起義既是亂局中的一環，也推著亂局加速。
causeEn: The root of the rising lay in the fact that the Sui had drained Shandong dry during the years of Daye. The emperor launched three great campaigns against the Liao, conscripting men from Shandong and Hebei, building war boats and hauling grain and weapons over long distances, while floods repeatedly devastated those two provinces and drove the hungry into flight; after Wang Bo rose at Changbai Mountain in the seventh year of Daye, revolts followed one another across Shandong and Hebei. The local garrisons were drawn off to the north-east and to Jiangdu, the commandery troops were hollow, grain and armour were mostly sent upward, and the counties held nothing but the old and weak together with villagers conscripted on the spot. Qi Gongshun was a native of Beihai and knew the hills, the roads and the distribution of villages around Yidu, so that he could gather thirty thousand men quickly without the authorities hearing of it and plant his camp close to the commandery city without being found. The court itself could no longer concentrate force: the commanders of the Henan area office chased the insurgents here and there, and wherever a column arrived a new revolt sprang up, while in the same year Liu Wuzhou rose at Taiyuan in the north and Xiao Xian held Jiangling in the south, so that the court was pressed on two fronts and had nothing to spare for Shandong. In the same period the bands of Dou Jiande, Zhang Jincheng, Liu Badao, Sun Anzu and Gao Shida were contesting ground among themselves in Shandong, so the rising of Qi Gongshun was both one episode of the disorder and a thing that pushed the disorder faster.
impact: 此役本身規模不大，延續時間亦短，卻留下幾重後果。對北海郡而言，一場三萬眾的強攻竟能破外城、入子城，說明隋末地方郡縣的城防與兵力已不敷使用，州郡各擁兵自守的局面成形，隋朝中央對山東的實際控制在一夕之間可以失守。對山東民變而言，綦公順之死使山東的抗隋力量重新洗牌，潰散之眾一部還鄉，一部併入竇建德、張金稱餘部，竇建德於是最終成為河北與山東的主導力量。戰役本身也示範了流民軍的極限：三萬眾足以破外城，卻不足以久圍子城，因為缺乏攻城器械與遠程投射，一斷糧就只剩反攻一途。更深一層的影響在制度上：府兵與州縣兵制在連年徵發下名存實亡，租庸調與均田的徵收線索被軍役切斷，戶口大量脫籍流亡，國家失去編戶齊民的稅基與兵源，隋末的崩解便由此加速。對後世兵家而言，此役亦是一個教科書式的守城反攻案例，說明攻城方一旦鬆懈、指揮斷裂，包圍與器械再多也不可恃，而守城方只要能保住一批精兵與一條出城的通道，就足以逆轉戰局。
impactEn: The rising was small in scale and short in duration, yet it left several consequences. For Beihai Commandery, the fact that a force of thirty thousand could break the outer city and enter the inner one showed that the defences and the manpower of the local prefectures and counties no longer sufficed; the pattern of each district arming and holding itself hardened, and the effective control of the Sui centre over Shandong could be lost overnight. For the revolts of Shandong, the death of Qi Gongshun shuffled the anti-Sui forces once more: part of the broken men went home and part were absorbed by the remnants of Dou Jiande and Zhang Jincheng, and Dou Jiande ended up as the dominant power in Hebei and Shandong. The campaign also showed the limits of an army of crowds: thirty thousand men were enough to break the outer city but not to hold the inner one for long, for without siege engines and without artillery at range, cutting the grain supply left them with nothing but a counterattack. Deeper still was the effect on the institutions: the fubing and the commandery and county levies had become names rather than things after years of conscription, the threads by which the land tax and the labour and commutation tax were collected were cut by the demands of the war, and great numbers of households slipped out of the registers and into flight, so that the state lost both its taxable base of registered families and its source of soldiers, and the collapse of the Sui was hastened. For later military writers the affair is a textbook case of a counterattack by a besieged city: once the besieger relaxes and its command breaks, no amount of siege works or machines can be relied on, while a defender who keeps a body of picked men and one clear way out of the city is enough to reverse the battle.
result: 夜襲成功之後，綦公順大營被破，主將綦公順死於亂軍之中，三萬眾當場崩散，餘眾或散歸鄉里、或為官軍所收、或轉投山東其他起義部眾，北海郡城重歸隋朝控制，郡府秩序一度恢復。劉蘭成因組織此夜襲而有功，記錄稱其因此見錄於史，惟其後的具體官職與封賞，今存史料未載。作為戰役，這是一場以攻方全勝開始、以攻方全敗告終的典型攻堅：破外城不難，難在子城，最後又被一次夜間突擊抹去全部戰果。若從全局看，綦公順起義的失敗並沒有改變隋亡的結局，反而加速了山東力量的集中，把舞台讓給了竇建德；同年劉武周取太原、李淵入長安，隋朝在一年之內連失重鎮與京師，起義本身的成敗已經無關大局。它留下的另一份意義，是給了後人一份可靠紀錄，知道在同一年裡，還有過這樣一場三萬眾攻郡城、卻在破城前夜因一念之差而全軍覆沒的戰役，也知道守城方如何靠一批精兵與一條暗道扭轉了攻守。
resultEn: After the night attack had succeeded, Qi Gongshun's camp was broken, the leader was killed in the rout, the thirty thousand scattered on the spot, and the survivors either went home, were taken by the Sui soldiers or turned over to the other rebel bands of Shandong. Beihai city passed back under Sui control and the order of the commandery was restored for a time. Liu Lancheng was rewarded for organising the night attack, the record noting that his services were entered in the history, though the office and the honours that followed are not given in the surviving texts. As a battle this is a classic siege that began with a complete victory for the assailant and ended in complete defeat for them: the outer city was easy enough to take, the inner city was the hard part, and in the end a single night sortie wiped out the whole result. Seen in the wider frame, the failure of Qi Gongshun's rising did nothing to avert the fall of the Sui; it merely hurried the concentration of the Shandong forces and handed the stage to Dou Jiande. In that same year Liu Wuzhou took Taiyuan and Li Yuan entered the capital, and the Sui lost great cities and the capital within twelve months, so that the fate of this rising no longer mattered to the course of the dynasty. It left behind one further kind of value, a dependable record, showing later generations that in that same year there had also been a battle in which thirty thousand men stormed a commandery city and, on the eve of its fall, were wiped out by a single lapse of attention, and showing how a besieged city turned the tables with a picked band of men and one concealed way out.
